hook: Deloitte Cyprus helped Roman Abramovich falsify 1,000 corporate papers to hide 10 billion dollars in assets.

sections.voiceover: Deloitte Cyprus helped Roman Abramovich falsify 1,000 corporate papers to hide 10 billion dollars in assets.
b_roll: Corporate documents being stamped in an accounting office

sections.voiceover: Meritservus signed off on accounts moving superyachts and private jets offshore. British Virgin Islands filings concealed those multi-million transfers from tax authorities. Where did 672 million dollars vanish?
Backdated paperwork bypassed international transparency rules completely.
b_roll: Close up of signature on financial ledger

sections.voiceover: Roman Abramovich sheltered mansions through shell companies. Deloitte auditors certified the fraudulent transactions. 508 million pounds disappeared off corporate balance sheets.
Track offshore shell companies hiding billionaire wealth.
